hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: The Practice Regarding the Blood Money of Teeth

Narrated by Abdullah ibn Abbas: Abu Ghattafan ibn Tarif al-Murri informed him that Marwan ibn al-Hakam sent him to Abdullah ibn Abbas asking him: What is (the blood money) for a molar tooth? So Abdullah ibn Abbas said: In it are five camels. He (Abu Ghattafan) said: Then Marwan sent me back to Abdullah ibn Abbas, and he said: Do you make the front of the mouth equal to the molar teeth? So Abdullah ibn Abbas said: If you were to consider that only by (the example of) fingers, their blood money is equal.

And a molar tooth is a tooth among the teeth; some of them do not have preference over others.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ ، كَانَا يَقُولَانِ فِي مُوضِحَةِ الْعَبْدِ : نِصْفُ عُشْرِ ثَمَنِهِ

hadiths.english_translation: Malik said: It reached him that Marwan ibn al-Hakam used to rule regarding a slave who is injured by wounds that upon the one who injured him is the measure of what decreased from the slave's price. Malik said: The practice among us is that for the muwidihah (exposing bone wound) of a slave is half of a tenth of his price, and for his munaqilah (fracturing bone wound) is a tenth and a half of a tenth of his price, and for his ma'mumah (brain-reaching wound) and his ja'ifah (body-cavity wound), in each one of them is a third of his price. And regarding what is other than these four characteristics from what a slave is injured with - what decreased from his price is evaluated after the slave recovers and heals, how much is between the value of the slave after the wound injured him and his value when healthy before this injured him, then the one who injured him pays what is between the two values. Malik said regarding a slave if his hand or leg is broken then his fracture heals: There is nothing upon the one who injured him. But if his fracture results in a decrease or limping, then upon the one who injured him is the measure of what decreased from the slave's price. Malik said: The practice among us regarding retaliation between slaves is like the form of retaliation of free people - the life of a female slave for the life of a male slave and her wound for his wound. So when a slave kills a slave intentionally, the master of the killed slave is given a choice: if he wishes he kills, and if he wishes he takes the blood money. If he takes the blood money, he takes the value of his slave. And if the master of the killer slave wishes to give the price of the killed slave, he does so, and if he wishes he surrenders his slave. When he surrenders him, there is nothing upon him other than that. And the master of the killed slave, when he takes the killer slave and is satisfied with him, cannot kill him. And that applies to all retaliation between slaves in cutting of hands and legs and the like - it is in the same position as killing. Malik said regarding a Muslim slave who injures a Jew or Christian: That the master of the slave, if he wishes to pay blood money for what he inflicted, he does so, or he surrenders him so he is sold and gives the Jew or Christian from the slave's price the blood money of his wound or all his price if it encompasses his price. And he does not give the Jew or Christian a Muslim slave.

الْعَبْدِ . قَالَ مَالِك : وَالْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا أَنَّ فِي مُوضِحَةِ الْعَبْدِ نِصْفَ عُشْرِ ثَمَنِهِ ، وَفِي مُنَقِّلَتِهِ الْعُشْرُ وَنِصْفُ الْعُشْرِ مِنْ ثَمَنِهِ ، وَفِي مَأْمُومَتِهِ وَجَائِفَتِهِ فِي كُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا ثُلُثُ ثَمَنِهِ ، وَفِيمَا سِوَى هَذِهِ الْخِصَالِ الْأَرْبَعِ ، مِمَّا يُصَابُ بِهِ الْعَبْدُ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ ثَمَنِهِ ، يُنْظَرُ فِي ذَلِكَ بَعْدَ مَا يَصِحُّ الْعَبْدُ وَيَبْرَأُ ، كَمْ بَيْنَ قِيمَةِ الْعَبْدِ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَصَابَهُ الْجُرْحُ ، وَقِيمَتِهِ صَحِيحًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصِيبَهُ هَذَا ، ثُمَّ يَغْرَمُ الَّذِي أَصَابَهُ مَا بَيْنَ الْقِيمَتَيْنِ . قَالَ مَالِك ، فِي الْعَبْدِ إِذَا كُسِرَتْ يَدُهُ أَوْ رِجْلُهُ ثُمَّ صَحَّ كَسْرُهُ : فَلَيْسَ عَلَى مَنْ أَصَابَهُ شَيْءٌ ، فَإِنْ أَصَابَ كَسْرَهُ ذَلِكَ نَقْصٌ أَوْ عَثَلٌ كَانَ عَلَى مَنْ أَصَابَهُ قَدْرُ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ ثَمَنِ الْعَبْدِ . قَالَ مَالِك : الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي الْقِصَاصِ بَيْنَ الْمَمَالِيكِ كَهَيْئَةِ قِصَاصِ الْأَحْرَارِ نَفْسُ الْأَمَةِ بِنَفْسِ الْعَبْدِ وَجُرْحُهَا بِجُرْحِهِ ، فَإِذَا قَتَلَ الْعَبْدُ عَبْدًا عَمْدًا خُيِّرَ سَيِّدُ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ ، فَإِنْ شَاءَ قَتَلَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَخَذَ الْعَقْلَ ، فَإِنْ أَخَذَ الْعَقْلَ أَخَذَ قِيمَةَ عَبْدِهِ ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ رَبُّ الْعَبْدِ الْقَاتِلِ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ فَعَلَ ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَسْلَمَ عَبْدَهُ فَإِذَا أَسْلَمَهُ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ ، وَلَيْسَ لِرَبِّ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْعَبْدَ الْقَاتِلَ وَرَضِيَ بِهِ أَنْ يَقْتُلَهُ ، وَذَلِكَ فِي الْقِصَاصِ كُلِّهِ بَيْنَ الْعَبِيدِ فِي قَطْعِ الْيَدِ وَالرِّجْلِ وَأَشْبَاهِ ذَلِكَ بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ فِي الْقَتْلِ . قَالَ مَالِك ، فِي الْعَبْدِ الْمُسْلِمِ يَجْرَحُ الْيَهُودِيَّ أَوِ النَّصْرَانِيَّ : إِنَّ سَيِّدَ الْعَبْدِ إِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَعْقِلَ عَنْهُ مَا قَدْ أَصَابَ فَعَلَ ، أَوْ أَسْلَمَهُ فَيُبَاعُ فَيُعْطِي الْيَهُودِيَّ أَوِ النَّصْرَانِيَّ مِنْ ثَمَنِ الْعَبْدِ دِيَةَ جُرْحِهِ أَوْ ثَمَنَهُ كُلَّهُ إِنْ أَحَاطَ بِثَمَنِهِ ، وَلَا يُعْطِي الْيَهُودِيَّ وَلَا النَّصْرَانِيَّ عَبْدًا مُسْلِمًا

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: What Has Come About the Blood Money of the People of the Covenant (Dhimmah)
hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي دِيَةِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated: It reached Malik that Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz ruled that the blood money of a Jew or Christian, when one of them is killed, is like half the blood money of a free Muslim. Malik said: The practice among us is that a Muslim is not killed for a disbeliever, except that a Muslim kills him by treacherous assassination, so he is killed for it.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ قَضَى أَنَّ دِيَةَ الْيَهُودِيِّ أَوِ النَّصْرَانِيِّ إِذَا قُتِلَ أَحَدُهُمَا مِثْلُ نِصْفِ دِيَةِ الْحُرِّ الْمُسْلِمِ . قَالَ مَالِك : الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا أَنْ لَا يُقْتَلَ مُسْلِمٌ بِكَافِرٍ ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَقْتُلَهُ مُسْلِمٌ قَتْلَ غِيلَةٍ فَيُقْتَلُ بِهِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Sulayman ibn Yasar: The blood money of a Magian is eight hundred dirhams. Malik said: And this is the practice among us. Malik said: The wounds of the Jew, Christian, and Magian - in their blood monies - are according to the calculation of the wounds of Muslims in their blood monies. The muwidihah (exposing bone) is half a tenth of his blood money, and the ma'mumah (brain-reaching wound) is a third of his blood money, and the ja'ifah (body-cavity wound) is a third of his blood money. So according to that calculation are all their wounds.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى ، عَنْ مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ ، كَانَ يَقُولُ : دِيَةُ الْمَجُوسِيِّ ثَمَانِيَ مِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ . قَالَ مَالِك : وَهُوَ الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا . قَالَ مَالِك : وَجِرَاحُ الْيَهُودِيِّ وَالنَّصْرَانِيِّ وَالْمَجُوسِيِّ فِي دِيَاتِهِمْ عَلَى حِسَابِ جِرَاحِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فِي دِيَاتِهِمُ الْمُوضِحَةُ نِصْفُ عُشْرِ دِيَتِهِ ، وَالْمَأْمُومَةُ ثُلُثُ دِيَتِهِ ، وَالْجَائِفَةُ ثُلُثُ دِيَتِهِ ، فَعَلَى حِسَابِ ذَلِكَ جِرَاحَاتُهُمْ كُلُّهَا

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: What Obligates Blood Money Upon a Man From His Own Wealth Specifically
hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ مَا يُوجِبُ الْعَقْلَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فِي خَاصَّةِ مَالِهِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Urwah ibn al-Zubayr: There is no blood money upon the 'aqilah (male relatives who share blood money responsibility) in intentional killing. Rather, upon them is the blood money of accidental killing.
